content:
Ava: Quick presales note 1: customer requires processing in DE (eu-central-1) with deterministic failover to CA (ca-central-1). Control plane must not transit US. BYOK (customer HSM) required. Any blockers?
Jon: Hosted control plane is US by default. Options: Private control-plane in customer VPC or Dedicated with regional control-plane (contract change). For POC, Private is fastest.
Meera: We can pin dataplane to eu-central-1 + ca-central-1 and disable telemetry exports. BYOK supported if keys live in customer's account. Need peering + IAM runbook.
Ava: They confirmed keys will be in their account (HSM in ca-central-1).
Jon: Network checklist: VPC peering/PrivateLink, mTLS cert, service account roles, KMS grant, telemetry opt-out.
Meera: Estimate 30-50 eng hours for Private deploy + KMS hookup. POC timeline ~10 business days if access provided.
LegalBot: We'll produce subprocessor list (cloud provider names + countries) and add SOW clause: "no control plane transit via US; telemetry disabled."
InfraBot: Ticket POC-9981 created and assigned to Meera: "DE primary / CA failover / customer BYOK".
Ava: Pricing ask: please put two SKUs in the quote - (1) 30d POC = setup + small reserved capacity + egress buffer, (2) Prod Private/Dedicated = monthly commit + BYOK integration fee + SLA uplift.
Jon: I'll draft routing snippet and sample SOW language and attach to deal deck.
Ava: Thanks. I'll share thread with customer and book ops sync for tomorrow.
